text:
jamie: Heads-up — planning a gradual v2 rollout in US regions starting in ~20m. We'll open routing to v2 at 5% and use a 15m telemetry gate between increments. Release notes: https://internal/release-notes/1759. Please avoid client-side pinning; if you have a special case, DM ops.

tariq: What's the exact rollback criteria? Need to document triggers asap.

jamie: If error rate > 1% (5m window) OR p95 latency +200ms vs baseline (5m), we trigger rollback. Also immediate per-tenant rollback if we see tenant-specific 5xx spike. deploy-bot will publish metrics after each step.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing change scheduled by @jamie at 1759001330. Plan: +5% traffic to v2, wait 15m, evaluate telemetry, repeat. I will post a summary after each increment.

sara: Are the release notes updated for streaming and header-case behavior? Some SDKs strip case for `X-Model-Version` which could break clients.

jamie: I added a header-case note and a streaming compatibility paragraph. Link above updated.

maria: Ops question — are we doing a regional stagger? Any tenant exclusions?

jamie: Yes: US-W -> US-E -> EU with 15m gaps. We'll keep known v1-only tenants on the skiplist.

tariq: @deploy-bot can you confirm which tenants are on the skiplist so we don't accidentally flip them?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Detected 4 tenants on v1-only skiplist: tenant-47, tenant-99, tenant-142, tenant-omega. Those will remain routed to v1 during this rollout.

ops-lead: If we encounter `ERR_SCHEMA_MISMATCH` or streaming handshake failures during step1, prefer per-tenant rollbacks first. Global rollback only if there's an infra-wide failure.

jamie: Agreed. Runbook added: https://go/runbook/v2-rollout. Follow per-tenant isolation steps before global undo.

sara: I'll watch the dashboards. Quick search I'll use for alerts: `service:api AND env:prod AND route:v2 AND http.status_code:>=500` and also monitor `streaming.connect.failures`.

maria: Operator rollback command for reference: `deployctl set-routing /api --weight v2=0` then `deployctl rollback --route /api/v2 --to v1` (notify CS after action).

tariq: One more ask — add explicit note in release docs about header example showing `X-Model-Version: 2025-01` and mention older SDKs may need upgrade.

jamie: Done. Ok team — starting step1 in ~20m. Reconvene after deploy-bot posts the step1 telemetry. :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: increment to 5% started (step1). I will post telemetry summary at completion of the 15m gate.
